items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the advance-payment assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter is dated 20.11.2026 but states Aufgabe zur Post as Samstag, 21.11.2026 — this stated posting day, not the document date, starts the clock. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (letters posted since 2025), the notice counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 21.11.2026 + 4 days = 25.11.2026 (Wednesday), a normal business day, so no shift is needed and deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) = 25.11.2026. Per § 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the one-month Einspruch period (§ 356 AO) begins on 26.11.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. 25.12.2026. That day is Erster Weihnachtstag, a nationwide public holiday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline moves to the next business day: 26.12.2026 (Zweiter Weihnachtstag) is also a holiday and 27.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline falls on Montag, 28.12.2026.
